title: Fetch repo info from GitHub API
instruction:
Write a program that uses the requests library to fetch data from the GitHub API at https://api.github.com/repos/python/cpython, checks that the status code is 200, and prints the repository name and star count.

Format: 'Repository: <name>, Stars: <count>'
solution_code:
import requests

response = requests.get("https://api.github.com/repos/python/cpython")
if response.status_code == 200:
    data = response.json()
    print(f"Repository: {data['name']}, Stars: {data['stargazers_count']}")
else:
    print(f"Request failed: {response.status_code}")

title: Save API data to JSON
instruction: Fetch data from https://api.github.com/repos/python/cpython, extract the 'name' and 'description' fields into a dictionary, and save it to 'repo.json' with indent=2 using the json module.
starter_code:
import requests
import json

# Your code here
solution_code:
import requests
import json

response = requests.get("https://api.github.com/repos/python/cpython")
if response.status_code == 200:
    data = response.json()
    repo_info = {
        "name": data["name"],
        "description": data["description"]
    }
    with open("repo.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump(repo_info, f, indent=2)
    print("Saved repo.json")
else:
    print(f"Request failed: {response.status_code}")
